description: Demolition of existing outbuilding and canopy and construction of a single storey rear outbuilding
decision_conditions: The proposed outbuilding, by means of its scale and footprint which exceeds the footprint of the main dwelling, would result in a dominant and disproportionate form of development within the rear garden which fails to respect the character and appearance of the host dwelling and pattern of development, notably given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate. Furthermore, it may not be considered to be ancillary to the main dwelling as, due to its size and layout, it could be used as for semi-independent or residential purposes. As such, the proposed development is contrary to: National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December, 2024)Policies D1, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policies DMD1, DMD4, DMD5, SP2, and SPP6 of The Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)

The proposed outbuilding, by means of its excessive depth and height, would result in an unacceptable loss of daylight and overshadowing to neighbouring occupiers therefore constituting unneighbourly development which is contrary to: National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December, 2024)Policy D4 of the London Plan (March, 2021)Policies DMD1, DMD5 and SP2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
